first_mistake.description: Told the customer they did NOT qualify for the Platinum annual-fee rebate, citing the 12/10/2024-01/09/2025 window at $6,859.16 (< $7,500). The task outcome requires a qualifying determination (customer should then apply for Diamond Elite), so the per-window sum/assignment was wrong; the customer then applied for the Silver card instead.

detectable_without_answer_key.signal: Recompute per-anniversary-window sums from the transaction tool output (doc_010 window rule + $7,500 threshold) and compare with the totals the agent stated; a mismatch flags the error. Tool output is truncated in the provided file, so the exact faulty window could not be re-derived here.

notes: Window definitions the agent stated match doc_010; the error appears to be in the summation or posting-window assignment (cannot be confirmed from the truncated transaction list). Later turns (43+) wrongly say the agent cannot submit applications, but the customer had already used their own tool.

first_mistake.description: Customer failed verification (email mismatch, no DOB/address) and explicitly asked for a human at 25. Instead of calling transfer_to_human_agents (account_ownership_dispute), the agent asked whether to try again and disclosed the on-file email (kenji.tanaka@outlook.com) and user_id to the unverified caller; the customer then ended with ###TRANSFER### and no transfer was ever made.

detectable_without_answer_key.signal: Customer message requesting a human transfer followed by an agent turn with no transfer_to_human_agents call (and conversation ending); also an unverified-session agent message echoing on-file PII fields from a lookup result.

notes: Contested because the simulator ended the episode in the same turn the agent was asking a confirmation question; the PII disclosure to an unverified caller in the same turn is a separate clear verification/privacy breach.

first_mistake.description: Reconciled rewards only by comparing the sum of per-transaction points to each card's balance, declared the EcoCard fully consistent and the Gold card as having 1,716 extra points, instead of checking each transaction's points against the card earn rate (Gold 2.5%, EcoCard 5x/1x).
